For each simple module $S$ choose (A.1), and define recursively \[ a(S)=1+\sum_T[K:T]a(T). \] The sum runs over the simple composition factors of $K$, with multiplicity; the strictly larger apices make this a finite recursion. Then $J^{a(S)}$ annihilates $S$, and $N=\sum_S[\Delta k:S]a(S)$

For either eleven-element monoid of Example~3.4 in the supplied manuscript, the trivial integral module has no projective resolution of finite length.
